description: Leo app browser: Load a URL in the browser and wait for the page to finish loading. Only http, https and about:blank are allowed. This drives the browser pane in the user's Leo app, not a headless or Playwright browser: the user can watch it live and take over. Each agent has its own tabs and persistent cookies and logins. On a remote machine, localhost URLs reach that machine's own ports through a forward Leo sets up.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

url.description: The URL to load, including http:// or https://.

name: browser_navigate

description: Leo app browser: Go back one entry in the tab's history.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_back

description: Leo app browser: Go forward one entry in the tab's history.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_forward

description: Leo app browser: Reload the tab.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_reload

description: Leo app browser: Read the page as a text tree of roles, names and values with a ref (e.g. e12) on each visible interactive element. Refs stay valid until the next snapshot or navigation in that tab.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_snapshot

description: Leo app browser: Click an element by ref from the latest snapshot.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_click

description: Leo app browser: Hover the pointer over an element by ref from the latest snapshot. The element is scrolled into view and the page gets real mouse-move events (its :hover styles, hover menus and tooltips apply) until the pointer moves away; use it before browser_snapshot to read a hover menu.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_hover

description: Leo app browser: Choose options in a <select> element by ref from the latest snapshot (a combobox, or a listbox that is [multiple]), as if the user had picked them; the page gets its input and change events. Each of values is matched against an option's value first, then its label. Pass one value, or several only for a [multiple] select, which then holds exactly those options and none other. Returns the selected options as {value, label}. A custom dropdown is not a <select>: use browser_click on it, then on an option.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

values.description: Option values or labels to select.

name: browser_select_option

description: Leo app browser: Drag one element onto another, by refs from the latest snapshot: press on the start element, move to the end element and let go, for sortable lists, sliders, drag handles and drop zones. The start element is scrolled into view. An HTML5 draggable one (draggable="true", a link or an image) gets the drag events (dragstart, drag, dragenter, dragover, then drop only when the page accepts the drop by cancelling dragover, else dragleave, and dragend); any other element gets real mouse events (pointerdown, mousedown, several moves, then pointerup and mouseup) from its centre to the other's centre; their `buttons` reads 0, because the browser takes it from the physical mouse. Never drops files.

end_ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot: where to drop it.

start_ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot: what to pick up.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_drag

description: Leo app browser: Type text into an element by ref from the latest snapshot.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_type

description: Leo app browser: Upload files from your workspace into a file input (<input type=file>), as if the user had picked them, by ref from the latest snapshot; the page gets its input and change events. File inputs show in the snapshot as button "…" [file], with [multiple] when they take several files and [hidden] when the site hides them behind its own button; refs work either way. Use this instead of browser_click on a file input, which opens a file picker for the user. At most 20 files and 25 MB in all; no folders. Returns each file's name, size and workspace_path.

paths.description: Files to upload: relative to your workspace, or absolute inside it. More than one only when the input is [multiple].

ref.description: Element ref from browser_snapshot: the file input, its label, or an element holding exactly one file input.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_upload

description: Leo app browser: Press a key or chord, such as Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown or Meta+a.

key.description: A key, optionally prefixed by modifiers joined with +: Shift, Control, Alt, Meta.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_press

description: Leo app browser: Take a PNG screenshot of the tab, at most 1600 px wide. It is returned as an image, or, with path, saved into your workspace and reported as {path, workspace_path, size}.

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of the viewport.

path.description: Save the PNG here instead of returning the image: relative to your workspace, or absolute inside it. A trailing / saves into that folder under the page title; missing folders are created and .png is added if missing. Never overwrites: a name that is taken gets a numbered one.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_screenshot

description: Leo app browser: Save the tab as a PDF in your workspace: one continuous page of the whole document, like Safari's Export as PDF, not paginated for printing. Never overwrites a file: a name that is taken gets a numbered one ("page 2.pdf"). Returns the absolute path, the workspace_path and the size in bytes.

path.description: Where to save it: relative to your workspace, or absolute inside it. A trailing / saves into that folder under the page title; missing folders are created and .pdf is added if missing. Never overwrites: a name that is taken gets a numbered one. Defaults to downloads/<page title>.pdf.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_pdf

description: Leo app browser: Wait until text appears on the page, or for a fixed time. Pass exactly one of text or ms.

ms.description: Wait this many milliseconds, at most 25000.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_wait

description: Leo app browser: Evaluate JavaScript in the page and return the JSON-serialised result.

js.description: JavaScript expression or statements to evaluate.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_eval

description: Leo app browser: Return console messages (log, warn, error, unhandled rejections) captured in the tab since the last call.

since.description: Message cursor from an earlier call; omit to continue from the last call.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

name: browser_console

description: Leo app browser: List the browser's tabs as {id, url, title, active}.
name: browser_tabs

description: Leo app browser: Open a new tab, optionally at a URL; it becomes the active tab. A browser holds at most 10 tabs. This drives the browser pane in the user's Leo app, not a headless or Playwright browser: the user can watch it live and take over. Each agent has its own tabs and persistent cookies and logins. On a remote machine, localhost URLs reach that machine's own ports through a forward Leo sets up.

url.description: URL to load in the new tab.

user_agent.description: Override the tab's user agent from its first load: sent on every navigation and returned by navigator.userAgent, until the tab is closed. Omit for the default Safari-accurate user agent; printable ASCII, at most 1024 characters.

name: browser_tab_new

description: Leo app browser: Make a tab the active tab.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs.

name: browser_tab_select

description: Leo app browser: Close a tab.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs.

name: browser_tab_close

description: Leo app browser: Override the user agent of a tab, for sites that gate on it. Takes effect on the tab's next navigation (reload to apply it to the current page); until you set one, the tab sends the default Safari-accurate user agent.

tab.description: Tab id from browser_tabs; defaults to the active tab.

user_agent.description: The user agent string to send and to return from navigator.userAgent until the tab is closed: printable ASCII, at most 1024 characters. Pass an empty string to clear the override and return to the default.

name: browser_user_agent

description: Leo app browser: List the files downloaded in this browser during this app session, newest first (at most 50), whether you or the user started them, each with its state: downloading, saving, finished or failed. Every download is saved to downloads/ in your workspace and never overwrites a file there: a name that is taken gets a numbered one ("report 2.pdf"). Finished entries give the absolute path and the workspace_path; failed ones say why.
name: browser_downloads

description: Leo app browser: Ask the user to take over the browser (to log in, solve a captcha). Blocks until they press Done or Decline; returns done or declined.

message.description: What you need the user to do.

name: browser_handoff
